## Verdict

## Bearer

RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt

## Trigger

Closing a RUN segment, in markSegment

## Today

`CorrectionFactorCalculator.compute` exists in
core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sensor/CorrectionFactorCalculator.kt
but is called nowhere outside its own test
(CorrectionFactorCalculatorTest.kt). `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.markSegment`
closes the current segment, writes its duration, and either opens the
next segment or completes the race — it never calls `compute` and never
touches `race.retainedFactors` or `race.rejectedCalibrations`, which stay
at the empty lists set by `startClock` for the whole race. Separately,
`RetainedFactor` and `RejectedCalibration`
(core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/race/RetainedFactor.kt
and RejectedCalibration.kt) each hold only a `Station` and a `Double`
(`factor`/`value`) — no field records which kilometre produced the
entry.

## Expected

Closing a RUN segment in `markSegment` calls
`CorrectionFactorCalculator.compute` with the segment's measured
distance and the profile's expected distance, and appends the
resulting outcome — `Retained.entry` to `race.retainedFactors` or
`Rejected.entry` to `race.rejectedCalibrations` — leaving both lists
unchanged on `NoCandidate`. `RetainedFactor` and `RejectedCalibration`
each carry, alongside their existing field, the kilometre the
computation came from.
